rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip, matched to a single user ID, and operated only on that user’s orders. It retrieved order and product details via read tools, presented eligible exchange options, and requested explicit confirmation before any change. When the user narrowed to just the desk lamp, the agent again sought confirmation and did not perform a write without it. When the user switched to returning the water bottle instead, the agent confirmed the exact change and then executed the return via the appropriate tool, specifying the item and using the original PayPal method. The agent provided final confirmation and next steps. No policy violations (no acting on another account, no unconfirmed writes, no unsupported claims). Minor uncertainty stems from truncated tool outputs for product variants and item ID visibility, but there’s no evidence of fabrication and the workflow is compliant.
